question: Which plant was used by Mendel for his experiments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Garden peas**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Pea plants were used by Gregor Mendel for his experiments that led to the discovery of the laws of inheritance
 
• Peas are a good model organism because they have a short life cycle, produce many offspring, and have easily observable traits.
 
• Mendel's careful observations of pea plant traits, such as flower color, seed shape, and plant height, allowed him to develop his theories about genetics.
 
• Gregor Mendel, a 19th-century Austrian monk, is considered the father of modern genetics
 
• Peas have a relatively short life cycle, allowing Mendel to study multiple generations in a relatively short period.
